# 03 — Error catalogue

*Derived from `gateway/src/error.rs`, `gateway/src/main.rs`, `gateway/src/handlers.rs`.*

## Failure cases

| Variant | Raised when |
|---|---|
| Validation | The request did not satisfy the schema. 422, as pydantic produces. |
| Upstream | The engine answered with an error, or could not be reached. |
| CapacityExhausted | The optimisation admission gate shed this request. |
| NotFound | No route matched. Starlette answers `{"detail":"Not Found"}`; axum's default fallback sends an empty body, so the tile handler raises this explicitly for a path FastAPI's route pattern would not have matched. |

## What the client receives

| Case | Status | `detail` |
|---|---|---|
| Validation | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | a list of validation errors |
| Upstream / Status | the engine's own, or `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` if it sent no valid one | the engine's `code` and `message`, or a bare string |
| Upstream / RequestTooLong | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | a list of validation errors |
| Upstream / ProfileUnavailable | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | a list of validation errors |
| Upstream / Unavailable | `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | `"Internal server error"` |
| NotFound | `NOT_FOUND` | `"Not Found"` |
| CapacityExhausted | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | `"Optimization capacity exhausted, retry shortly"` |

## Statuses produced outside `ApiError`

Rate limiting, the panic guard, readiness and the method fallback answer directly.

| Status | Site | Function |
|---|---|---|
| METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED | `gateway/src/handlers.rs:528` | pub async fn method_not_allowed() -> Response |
| OK | `gateway/src/handlers.rs:574` | pub async fn ready(State(state): State<AppState>) -> (StatusCode, Json<Value>) |
| INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR | `gateway/src/main.rs:314` | fn panic_response(panic: Box<dyn std::any::Any + Send + 'static>) -> Response |
| TOO_MANY_REQUESTS | `gateway/src/main.rs:344` | async fn rate_limit(State(state): State<AppState>, ConnectInfo(peer): ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>, |
